description: Call this when validate_definition reports issues with safe fixes, such as a misspelled property name, a missing id or key, an empty label, a one-letter typo in a condition field, a duplicate key nothing refers to or a missing submit button. Applies every safe fix and returns { definition, applied, valid, issues }: the repaired definition, the fixes applied in order, and the issues left, the same as validate_definition returns for the repaired definition. Safe fixes never change what the form does beyond the repair. Unsafe fixes, such as pointing a condition at a field two edits away, stay in issues[].fixes for you to check and apply by hand. Save the returned definition, then fix the remaining errors.

definition.description: Formhaus form definition as a JSON object or a JSON string. JSON Schema: https://formhaus.dev/schema/form-definition.json. Top level: id, title, submit { label }, and fields (one step) or steps [{ id, title, fields }]. Field: { key, type, label, validation?, options?, show?, showAny? }. Rules go inside "validation": { required, minLength, maxLength, min, max, pattern, matchField }. Condition: { field, eq | neq | in | notIn | contains | notContains | notEmpty | gt | gte | lt | lte } with exactly one operator, on a field of the same or an earlier step. Optional: lang, messages and labels catalogs, and i18n objects that map texts to translation keys.

name: fix_definition

applied.description: Fixes applied, in order. path is where the issue was before the fix.

definition.description: The definition with every safe fix applied. Missing when the input is not a JSON object.

issues.description: Issues left after the safe fixes. Errors first, then warnings. Fix them by hand or apply one of their unsafe fixes after checking it.

fixes.description: Ready repairs for this issue. Apply one patch to the definition, then validate again.

patch.description: RFC 6902 JSON Patch operations (add, replace, remove, move) with JSON pointer paths.

safe.description: true when applying the patch only repairs the issue and changes nothing else. fix_definition applies these.

path.description: JSON pointer to the node, such as /steps/0/fields/1/show/0/field.

valid.description: false when at least one issue has severity "error".

title: Apply safe fixes to a Formhaus definition
